title: Class 4: Show and tell

series.title: Physical AI Lab: Build a Robot Desk Assistant (4 evenings)

summary: The finale. A short polish session, then every robot gets the floor: show its look, its personalities and the coolest thing it can do. Guests welcome.
detail: The first half hour is open studio: catch up on anything you missed, fix anything wobbly, and rehearse. Then show and tell: each builder gets a couple of minutes to introduce their robot, switch it between personalities, and show off its best skill, live, in front of the room. We film every robot, and the room votes.
outcome: Your robot shown off to a live audience, and a clip of it.
artifact: A finished talking robot and a video of it in front of guests.
prereqs: Your robot, charged if it runs on a Pi or a BreadVolt.
Its brain: your laptop, your phone (charged, for Bluetooth robots), or your laptop to open your Pi with Raspberry Pi Connect.
Robot lab files (the robot program and anything else we share): https://dgeventhub.com/downloads/cardboard-robot/

troubleshooting: Behind? Ask a helper for the kit for the stage you're on. You can demo at any stage, from a laptop, a phone or a Pi.
It talks over people in the noisy room: raise Patience a little, or switch off barge-in.
The battery dies mid-demo: helpers have charged spares, or run it from your laptop.
A Bluetooth robot drops mid-demo: keep the phone's screen on and stay near the robot. Reconnect with Connect by Bluetooth, or plug it into a laptop.
Connect robot does nothing at all: you're not in Chrome. Open the page in Chrome (or Chromium on a Raspberry Pi).
Another program is using the port: quit Thonny and close other tabs with this page, unplug the Pico, plug it back in, and connect again.

The page says the robot reset while talking: a servo is pulling power from the Pico. Check every red wire goes to the + row, the BreadVolt is switched on or the power lead is in a charger, nothing is on pin 40, and the ground jumper to pin 23 is in.
It cuts you off: raise Patience. It's slow to answer: lower it.
It talks to itself, or stops mid-sentence for no reason: it's hearing its own voice. Switch off Let me interrupt it (barge-in), or move the laptop away from the robot's speaker.
Deepgram stopped the session: check the key was pasted whole, and that the account has credit.
